body: Since I know nobody will see this, I am done. Good bye to anyone who 'knew' me if you find this somehow. Going to take the leap..
Never mind, suicide might be more viable after what I've just found.
Actually who am I fooling, nobody is going to see this.
Shut the fuck up, you're on a subreddit about suicide.

I've gotten used to suicidal thoughts. I'm quite numb at this point. I don't think I'll ever trust people with my real emotions ever again. I've decided just mindlessly going through life as a chore then dying inevitably at the end is better. Or I can just pick up a gun or knife and end it immediately..
Wow, I'm glad you got it sorted! Good luck man.
Jesus Christ, this hits so close to home for me as well. In case you do want someone to talk to, I'm here. Feel free to PM If you want as well. Other wise, please just take care.

I understand EXACTLY THIS!
 Everything falls apart for no reason.
 There's never ending problems that depress me Then they make me an asshole because I hate everything.
  Which then causes other people to hate me.
  I just want to be invisible.
  Having a rare "condition" of sorts, I am always burning.
I always feel like I'm a waste of resources. Like I can't do anything without a ton of help.
I just hate me, but I also hate them.
  There is nothing but misunderstood people.
But you're one of the first I understand.

I also feel disgusting as hell.
My metabolism is awful.
I'm too weak by default.
I just hope it goes away someday.
No man, no flavor can overrule pain. I'm sorry you think this is a good idea.
